name.pt-BR: Cartas sobre o caso do quietismo (I)

description.fr-FR: Les lettres de Bossuet et de ses correspondants sur l’affaire du quiétisme, de 1694 à 1698 : Mme Guyon, M. Tronson, Fénelon, M. de Noailles, puis la correspondance avec son neveu l’abbé Bossuet et l’abbé Phelippeaux, à Rome. Édition Lachat (1864), tomes XXVIII-XXIX.
description.en-US: The letters of Bossuet and his correspondents on the Quietist affair, 1694 to 1698: Madame Guyon, M. Tronson, Fénelon, M. de Noailles, then the correspondence with his nephew the abbé Bossuet and the abbé Phelippeaux in Rome. Lachat edition (1864), volumes XXVIII-XXIX.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Bossuet e de seus correspondentes sobre o caso do quietismo, de 1694 a 1698: a sra. Guyon, o sr. Tronson, Fénelon, o sr. de Noailles, depois a correspondência com o sobrinho, o abade Bossuet, e com o abade Phelippeaux, em Roma. Edição Lachat (1864), tomos XXVIII-XXIX.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXVIII pages 014-017 and volume XXIX pages 002-017 (Lettres sur l’affaire du quiétisme; the cover page 029/001 was not captured). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
